title: In Canada, Watching the N.H.L. Has Become Expensive and Cumbersome
summary_full: Games behind paywalls and exorbitant costs forcing a drop in attendance — even to watch Connor McDavid in Edmonton — have only compounded the loss of a Saturday night ritual.
